meta.title: Godet — the garage for your equipment fleet
meta.description: The digital maintenance log for construction machinery: services, repairs, parts, costs, photos, videos and due dates. Free 30-day trial, no credit card required.
meta.ogDescription: Every machine gets its complete log. No more missed inspections, and clear costs for every machine.

footer.tagline: The digital maintenance log for construction machinery, designed in Switzerland for construction companies.
footer.studio: An application by <link>Swiss Digital Studio</link>, in Valais, Switzerland.

hero.title: The garage for your equipment fleet
hero.lead: Every machine gets its complete log: services, repairs, parts, costs, photos, videos and due dates. Inspections are no longer forgotten. And at last you know what each machine really costs.

stage.alt: Godet’s 3D showroom: an excavator on its illuminated platform, with its maintenance record.
stage.cta: Enter the showroom · no account needed

problem.title: Paper logbooks can no longer keep up with the site
problem.text: Five, twenty or fifty machines, several sites, a team that rotates. Along the way, information gets lost.

paper.title: Paper logbooks
paper.text: They stay in the cab, get dirty and go missing. Nobody really knows where a machine stands.

invoices.title: Scattered invoices
invoices.text: Between the binder, the inbox and the van, a machine’s history becomes impossible to find.

checks.title: Forgotten inspections
checks.text: The 500-hour service or the annual safety inspection slips through the cracks. You find out too late.

costs.title: Unclear costs
costs.text: Nobody can say what a machine cost this year, or whether it is time to replace it.

features.title: All your fleet maintenance in one place
features.text: The history, due dates and costs of every machine, together in a single garage. On computer, tablet and phone.

log.title: The complete log
log.text: Services, safety checks, repairs, parts and notes. Every entry keeps its date, the hour meter reading, who did the work and what it cost.

dues.title: Due dates by hours or by date
dues.text: Service every 500 h, annual safety inspection: Godet follows each machine’s actual usage and reminds you before anything falls due.

costs.title: Costs per machine
costs.text: Parts, labour, downtime: what each machine has cost over twelve months, month by month.

media.title: Photos, videos, documents
media.text: Photograph a leak, film a suspicious noise, upload the invoice as a PDF. Everything stays attached to the machine.

team.title: Team and roles
team.text: Owner, administrator, mechanic, operator: everyone sees the fleet according to their role.

workshop.title: Workshop mode, without 3D
workshop.text: A fast list view on any device, to log hours and work without detours.

print.title: The printed log
print.text: A machine’s log can be printed or saved as a PDF: for an inspection, an appraisal or a resale.

showroom.title: A showroom for your fleet
showroom.text: Every machine on its platform, its condition visible at a glance: green, orange or red.

videos.title: Godet in action
videos.text: Two short silent films with subtitles: the 3D showroom, then a machine followed up in workshop mode.

garage.title: The 3D garage
garage.text: The hall lights up, an excavator and a boom lift wake up, then the whole fleet appears with the status of every machine.

suivi.title: Keeping maintenance on track
suivi.text: A dumper overdue for its service: its record, the entry logged in seconds, the log, the next due date and the costs.

compliance.title: A log that stands up to an inspection
compliance.quote: The results of maintenance work must be recorded.
compliance.caption: Swiss Ordinance on the Prevention of Accidents and Occupational Diseases (OPA, SR 832.30), Art. 32b (unofficial translation). Godet records every job with its date, who did it and what it cost. Wherever you work, a complete log is your evidence during an inspection.

kept.title: Nothing is erased
kept.text: An incorrect entry is withdrawn with a reason. It stays visible, struck through, in the history.

journal.title: Every change is logged
journal.text: Who entered, edited or withdrew what, and when.

archive.title: Machines are archived
archive.text: A sold or decommissioned machine leaves the showroom. Its log remains available and printable.

compliance.note: Godet makes it easier to keep the log. Maintaining work equipment remains the employer’s responsibility.

local.title: Designed in Valais, for construction companies everywhere
local.text: Godet speaks the language of the site and fits the way you work.

formats.title: Your own formats
formats.text: Hours, amounts and dates appear the way you write them, in Swiss francs, euros or pounds.

language.title: In everyone’s language
language.text: English, French, German or Italian: everyone chooses their own language. Service every 500 h, hour meter, annual inspection: the vocabulary of the workshop.

hosting.title: Data hosted in the EU
hosting.text: The database and files are hosted in Ireland, in the European Union.

access.title: Access for your company only
access.text: Each company sees only its own data. Access rules are enforced by the database itself.

pricing.title: Free 30-day trial
pricing.text: No credit card required. Pricing will be announced before your trial ends.
pricing.small: All features are available during the trial.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Godet runs in the browser, on a computer, tablet or phone. You can add it to your home screen like an app.

threeD.a: No. Workshop mode shows the fleet as a list, without 3D. It suits modest devices and quick data entry.

data.a: Only the people you invite to your company, according to their role. The data is hosted in the EU, in Ireland.

erase.a: It can be withdrawn, with a reason. It stays visible in the history: that is what gives the log its value during an inspection.

export.q: Can we take the log out of Godet?
export.a: Yes. Every log can be printed or saved as a PDF, with all work, repairs, parts and costs.

languages.q: Is Godet available in other languages?
languages.a: Yes: in English, French, German and Italian. Everyone chooses their language, and amounts are shown in your company’s currency.

trial.a: Pricing will be announced before the 30 days are up. No credit card is needed to try Godet.

final.title: Open your garage
final.text: Visit the demo without an account, or create your garage and add your first machine.
final.contact: A question, or a demo for your team? <link>Write to us</link>.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The page could not be displayed. Nothing you had already saved is lost: try again, or come back in a moment.
